newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Horsemen ride into sunset after robbing liquor shop.
newsitem.headline: Horsemen ride into sunset after robbing liquor shop.

text.p: Four horsemen rode into town in a remote part of South Africa and robbed a liquor store before riding off into the sunset, police said on Thursday.
The gunmen ordered the cashier and customers onto the floor of the store in Qumbu, in the Eastern Cape, on Wednesday afternoon.
They then helped themselves to 247 rand ($54) and rode away.
"It's not something we normally see. Suspects usually run away on foot or escape by motor vehicle," said a police spokesman. No one was hurt, and no suspects had been caught.
